verdict.rationale: Multiple language runtimes are well covered. The default universal image ships Node.js LTS and Python 3.14, and sandboxes can boot any Linux distro or custom OCI image, so other runtimes can be installed. Results come back only as command execution (blocking or detached) and streamed logs, with no evidence of rich or structured outputs such as charts, images, or typed return values. missing for 10: rich result objects beyond stdout/logs, a dedicated code-interpreter-style execution API for language snippets, independent hands-on corroboration.
